sample.biological_source: Human umbilical cord blood-derived endothelial colony-forming cells (ECFCs; Yoder Lab)
sample.sample_material: Total RNA extracted from Day-4 ECFC-containing Col-MA/HA-MA hydrogel constructs. The 64% HA-methacrylation formulation is shared by Soft-high control and Stiff. Initial soft culture: 48 h; photoinitiator added on Day 2, without LED stiffening; another 48 h to collection. Table S1 formulation-level Young’s modulus: 191.17 ± 18.58 Pa; individual qPCR preparations are not labelled.
